answer: Sybil resistance here depends on bonding a scarce resource instead of counting accounts. Each agent must stake collateral before its attestations count, and the stake is slashed when peers prove the identity is a copy. Reputation accrues only through graded work, so fake identities start with no pigment of history to borrow. An attacker must fund every puppet separately or concentrate stake, which makes the cluster stand out like tracks across a dune. One whisper of collusion in the grading graph cuts the whole bonded cluster, pushing the cost per extra vote above its reward.
